breakdown.description: For curved submerged surfaces, the horizontal component equals the hydrostatic force on the vertical projection (not the horizontal projection).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: 'using the horizontal projection area of the curved surface.' The ground truth requires using the VERTICAL projection. This inconsistency was not fixed.

breakdown.description: The vertical component is obtained from the weight of the fluid volume above the surface, not from projecting the area in the same way as the horizontal component.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says 'using the appropriate projection method as requested,' which is vague and does not explicitly state that the vertical component is the weight of the imaginary column of water above the curved surface up to the free surface, as required by the ground truth.
